strings.zh: 通往１９号水路的沙滩{NEWLINE}由于火山喷发的关系,{CLEAR}现在禁止通行。{SCROLL}红莲岛的居民没什么事吧？
strings.en: The beach to Route 19 is closed for now{NEWLINE}because of the volcanic eruption. Are{CLEAR}the people of Cinnabar Island all right?
strings.notes: US 0741/0 | RV028: addition: 现在 is "for now", not "indefinitely"; question restored (coordinator)

strings.zh: 红莲岛的人们没事{NEWLINE}真是太好了！
strings.en: I’m so glad to hear that no Cinnabar{NEWLINE}citizens were injured by the eruption!

strings.zh: 本来我和皮卡丘{NEWLINE}要去19号水路练习冲浪的,{CLEAR}但是因为封路的关系只能先等等了。
strings.en: Pikachu and I were going to practice{NEWLINE}surfing on Route 19, but with the route{CLEAR}closed, we’ll just have to wait.
